title: Mario + Rabbids Kingdom Battle
subtitle: A comic collision becomes a tactics game
summary: Mario + Rabbids Kingdom Battle is Ubisoft Milan and Ubisoft Paris's tactical adventure, released for Switch on 29 August 2017.
body: Mario + Rabbids Kingdom Battle is Ubisoft Milan and Ubisoft Paris's tactical adventure, released for Switch on 29 August 2017. Mario and his friends join Rabbid counterparts after a mishap transforms the Mushroom Kingdom. The journey alternates exploration and puzzles with turn-based battles, giving familiar characters another way to cooperate. Bright environments and exaggerated animation make the crossover immediately comic, while each arena asks a concrete tactical question: where to move a small team so that its attacks and protection work together.

The player selects a squad whose characters offer different weapons and abilities. Cover changes the risk of a position, while movement can contribute directly to an attack or help a teammate reach another part of the arena. Planning a turn therefore involves more than choosing a target. The useful route may connect several actions before the final shot, making cooperation visible in the characters' movement. The battlefield gives a clear space in which to test that plan and see how the opponents respond on their turn.

Director Davide Soliani and producer Xavier Manzanares began shaping the project in 2014, pursuing a strategy game that could draw on the differences between its two worlds. Grant Kirkhope composed the music. Four main environments connect the battles through exploration, with Beep-0 gaining new puzzle-solving abilities as the adventure advances. A Donkey Kong expansion followed in 2018. The original game's identity comes from making those unlikely partners useful to one another, joining a carefully arranged tactical encounter to the visual playfulness of the Mushroom Kingdom.
